scope: Exact canonical initial scene; current committed facts are evaluated at projection time, not authored as initial observations

source_refs.selector: canonical initial composition and appearance profile references

canonical_binding.runtime_entity_binding: Resolve exact current committed placements. A template slot or compatibility anchor does not establish entity existence or visibility.

perception_owner.base_geometry: Use current committed positions and G6. Same G6 with default_clear supplies clear base geometry; same G6 with explicit mode and different G6 require a directed visibility_link. Portal state limits a linked relation.
perception_owner.conditions: Use actual Temporal lighting and weather plus active committed visibility modifiers at the affected scope. Read the complete current modifier set; a complete empty set contributes clear conditions. Missing or incomplete owner state is a typed gap, not an empty set.
perception_owner.result: The resolver combines base geometry, portal and current conditions as clear, partial or none. No authored per-entity stable_cover, dynamic_occlusion or concealment values are transferred from the natural-layer initial rule.

npc_boundary.existence_and_position: Only actual committed NPC instances and positions; approved composition is not an observed entity list.
npc_boundary.visible_exterior: After visual admission, use committed Stage 16 actor appearance and exterior equipped-item visual state only.
npc_boundary.identity: Expose a name, role or other identity only from committed player knowledge; objective NPC facts alone do not establish recognition.

item_boundary.ground_items: Only actual committed item placements and visible exterior facts after the same current visibility resolution; a catalog stock class is not an item instance.
item_boundary.other_actor_equipment: Only visible exterior equipment of an admitted actor from committed Stage 16 placements; do not expose concealed contents or ownership by inference.
item_boundary.own_items: Use the existing player-safe inventory projection for committed owned or held items.

exit_boundary.visibility: Resolve the current committed exit target position or anchor through base geometry and current conditions; expose only partial or clear results.
exit_boundary.label: Use an independently approved player-safe label only.
exit_boundary.destination: Keep factual destination hidden unless committed player knowledge separately permits it.

provenance.reviewed_predecessor_scope: The pinned v1 approval covers only gap analysis and excludes runtime use; it does not approve this successor.

review_request.scope: Review exact successor applicability and source provenance; separately decide data approval. Do not infer import, runtime activation or release authorization.
